title: A test: ore gathered at Acrux Belt (lithium, iron, copper) into the faction's storage at our outpost CLTV Outpost GSC-0044 (one jump); members of the faction only
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-21 19:51 UTC (orders.log ENT-056, block ZERO: fly the outpost's belts with your faction miners; rules F3, F24). Acrux Belt read lithium 1,672 of 25,000 at richness 36, iron 74,875 (64), copper 99,873 (36) (table fields, 2026-11-21 19:34 UTC), one jump from GSC-0044 by the lanes; the reserve is short of 120 lithium ore and holds none (the tool stock, view=reserve, 19:34 UTC).
